summary: The agent provided an exceptionally robust and high-quality solution. It correctly implements a 5-fold cross-validation scheme, extracts a rich set of features (including text TF-IDF with SVD, out-of-fold target encoding, and datetime features), trains a diverse set of models (including a custom PyTorch Tabular ResNet and multiple GBDTs trained on both log-transformed targets and robust Huber objectives), and optimally ensembles them using SLSQP. No data leakage or data science anti-patterns were detected.
